summary: ADR-0094 selects distinct prospective V3 original-intent, effect-grant and receiver-command/ACK issuers and UTEL descriptor issuer in dedicated protected-main .github CI environments under Programme custody, plus separate supervised SystemAdmin host identities/stores for V3 attestation, UTEL phase proofs and external ACKs. Secret-free Coordination verifiers use independent purpose-specific pins. Programme also selects existing-node shared TLS hostname/terminator custody for V3 source preparation: separate HTTPS8443 origin, fixed POST exchange path and dedicated loopback18443 backend; the hostname remains restricted and private443 must remain unchanged. The shared TLS administrator is a common transport trust boundary, supplying no original, grant, attestation or ACK authority; purpose signing keys remain separate and independently enrolled. Joined source limits, OIDC allowlist, pin/rotation/readback policy and explicit certificate/tailnet-policy changes precede separate provisioning admission. No endpoint, keys, enrollment, Funnel command, dispatch or native acceptance is established or admitted. The operative UTEL cap stays 65,536 pending complete physical-copy accounting; .103 remains attempted-unknown/unreplayed and .104/native effects held.
title: Separate V3 and UTEL signing custody with shared V3 TLS transport
